info.title: Choreo Local API
info.description: Resource-oriented API for the locally running Choreo server. The server owns one active project. Session open/new/save and generation-start requests return 202 after enqueueing work; operation outcomes and generator progress arrive over the WebSocket event channel. Subscribe before issuing long-running requests. Events are not replayed, so clients must refetch the snapshot after a revision gap.

post.summary: Save modified active files, then open a project or show the file picker

202.description: Session open was accepted; completion is reported over the events WebSocket. If saving modified current files fails, the current session remains active.

post.summary: Save modified active files, then create a project from a v4 document

202.description: Session creation was accepted; completion is reported over the events WebSocket. If saving modified current files fails, the current session remains active.

post.summary: Save modified files and close the active project, cancelling active generation

202.description: Session close was accepted; completion or SAVE_FAILED is reported over the events WebSocket

202.description: Session save was accepted; completion is reported over the events WebSocket
